item.title: “We Suffocate Alone”: India’s Hidden Crisis Of Women’s Mental Health
item.description: Women’s mental health in India is not an individual failing but a structural crisis shaped by violence, unpaid caregiving, emotional labour, and enforced silence. Across regions, women endure fear, isolation, and exhaustion while holding families and systems together—often without recognition, safety, or support. Listening to their lived realities is the first step toward real change.

item.title: Mental Health at Work: 5 Truths Employees Are Unlikely to Talk About
item.description: Mental Health at Work is often most strained during the holiday season, when expectations of cheer collide with hidden stress and trauma. Many employees appear capable while silently struggling. Recognizing these unspoken realities helps organizations create psychologically safer, more humane workplaces—especially in December, when pressure, comparison, and exhaustion peak.
